content_sections.heading: Age Calculation Date
content_sections.text: The cut-off date for determining the candidate's age and eligibility is 1 July 2026 .

content_sections.heading: Post-Wise Wages
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will receive daily wages according to the minimum wages notified by the Labour Department, Government of NCT of Delhi.

content_sections.heading: One-Time Registration Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates must complete their online registration and pay the one-time registration fee at least one day before the scheduled walk-in interview. Proof of payment printed from the candidate's ICSIL profile must be produced at the interview venue.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The ICSIL DSIIDC selection process will include: Online registration and payment of the registration fee Scrutiny of age, qualification and experience documents Shortlisting of eligible candidates Interview or interaction with the department Skill test or written test, if required for the post Final selection by the interview panel or department Contractual deployment in DSIIDC Appearing for the walk-in interview does not guarantee selection or deployment. The decision of the interview panel will be final.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Walk-in Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring the following documents: Printout of the ICSIL online registration details Proof of payment of the Rs.590 one-time registration fee Original date-of-birth certificate Original educational qualification certificates Original experience certificates One set of photocopies of all relevant documents Two recent photographs Class 10 certificate PAN card Aadhaar card Proof of name change, if the candidate's current name differs from the Class 10 certificate

content_sections.heading: Walk-in Interview Venue
content_sections.text: Intelligent Communication Systems India Limited Administrative Building, 1st Floor Above Post Office Okhla Industrial Estate, Phase III New Delhi - 110020

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICSIL DSIIDC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official ICSIL website. Complete the online one-time registration process. Pay the non-refundable registration fee of Rs.590. Print the registration-fee payment proof from the “Manage Profile” section. Check the qualification, experience and age requirements for the preferred post. Collect the original certificates and one set of photocopies. Carry two recent photographs and valid identity documents. Attend the walk-in interview on the scheduled date and time.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only candidates registered online through the ICSIL website will be considered. The registration fee should be paid at least one day before the walk-in interview. Candidates without original documents will not be allowed to participate. No TA or DA will be paid for attending the interview, interaction or document verification. The place of deployment may be anywhere in Delhi/NCR. Candidates may be required to work in shifts or on a rotational basis. No additional conveyance allowance will be provided. The engagement will be purely contractual and temporary. The engagement does not provide any right to claim regular appointment. Incomplete applications will be rejected. Canvassing or attempting to influence the recruitment process will result in disqualification. Candidates should regularly check the ICSIL website for corrigenda and recruitment updates.

content_sections.heading: Security Deposit from Selected Candidates
content_sections.text: Fifteen days' salary will be deducted from selected candidates as security in two instalments: 50% of the security amount from the first month's salary Remaining 50% from the second month's salary The amount will be refunded with applicable savings-bank interest after the candidate completes the contractual obligations and a No Dues Certificate is received from the client department.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under ICSIL DSIIDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 20 vacancies have been announced.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are included in the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Data Entry Operator, Salesperson and Helper posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a graduation degree or equivalent qualification and an English typing speed of 30 words per minute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Salesperson?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 12 and possess at least two years of experience in sales or retail.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Helper?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 8 and possess at least one year of experience in sales or retail.

faq.question: Q6. What are the walk-in dates?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Data Entry Operator and Salesperson will be held on 26 September 2026. The Helper interview will be held on 27 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the registration fee?
faq.answer: Candidates must pay a non-refundable one-time registration fee of Rs.590.
